WITH sales AS (
  SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS q1_units,
         SUM(CAST(i.sale_price AS NUMERIC)) AS q1_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` AS i FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF @snapshot
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` AS o FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF @snapshot ON o.order_id=i.order_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` AS p FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF @snapshot ON p.id=i.product_id
  WHERE i.created_at >= TIMESTAMP('2026-01-01') AND i.created_at < TIMESTAMP('2026-04-01')
    AND i.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned') AND o.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned')
  GROUP BY p.category
), stock AS (
  SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS stock_units,
         SUM(CAST(i.cost AS NUMERIC)) AS stock_cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.inventory_items` AS i FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF @snapshot
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` AS p FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF @snapshot ON p.id=i.product_id
  WHERE i.created_at <= @cutoff AND (i.sold_at IS NULL OR i.sold_at > @cutoff)
    AND (i.sold_at IS NULL OR i.sold_at >= i.created_at)
  GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT COALESCE(s.category,t.category) AS category, s.q1_units, s.q1_revenue,
       t.stock_units,t.stock_cost FROM sales s FULL OUTER JOIN stock t USING(category)
ORDER BY category
